description:
Read one shared code module: its code, its version (the baseVersion r3_module_write needs), the latest version, its notes, and how many of this account's projects use it. Your own module by name; someone else's PUBLIC module by moduleId. version reads an older version.

A long module is read in PAGES (at most 60000 characters each): every answer gives totalChars, the sha256 of the WHOLE code, and truncated / nextOffset. When truncated is true you have only part of it: read on with the same name, the version answered and offset = nextOffset, join the pages, and check the sha256 before you write it back (half a module written back deletes the rest).

length.description: How many characters to read at most (default and maximum 60000; 8000 in an R3 Builder session). A page ends on a whole line when it can.

moduleId.description: Instead of name: a module id (someone else's public module).

offset.description: Where to start reading, in characters (default 0). For the next page pass the nextOffset of the previous answer.

version.description: A version to read (default: the latest). Pass it when reading the next page.

name: r3_module_read

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Read a shared code module
